Security token information

np_whoami.Rd

Query the Windows access token associated with a named pipe client or with the calling R process.

np_whoami() returns information about a token's user. np_token_info() returns the full token details.

Usage

np_whoami(con = NULL)

np_token_info(con = NULL)

Arguments

con

[winpipe] or NULL.

The server end of a connected pipe, to query the connected client's token, or NULL (default) to query the token of the R process itself.

Value

np_whoami() returns a string of the form "DOMAIN\user".

np_token_info() returns a list with:

  • user: user name as "DOMAIN\user".

  • sid: user SID string.

  • groups: a data frame of group names, SIDs, and whether each group is enabled.

  • elevated: whether the token is elevated (UAC).

  • integrity: integrity level ("low", "medium", "high", or "system").

  • token_type: "primary" (own process) or "impersonation" (pipe client).

  • impersonation_level: for impersonation tokens, one of "anonymous", "identification", "impersonation", or "delegation"; NA for primary tokens.

Examples

# If no argument is provided, returns the SID
# of the R session
np_whoami()
#> [1] "runnervmdaln5\\runneradmin"

# If a server-client structure is provided
# returns the SID of the client
server <- winpipe("test")
client <- winpipe("test")
np_whoami(server)
#> [1] "S-1-5-21-3776380004-1005456608-3524014338-500"

close(client)
close(server)
